name: 模拟华附
group_note: Campus-themed mudlib (模拟华附, set at 华南师范大学附属中学). WASM pass: fixed two bugs. (1) cmds/usr/uptime.lpc's write(read_file("/log/nosave/LASTCRASH")) (§7.54 class) -- the file doesn't exist on a fresh checkout, read_file() returns 0, and write(0) crashes with 'Bad argument 1 to receive()'; since UPTIME_CMD->main() runs during EVERY logon() before the id prompt, this crashed and disconnected every single connection attempt. Guarded with stringp(). (2) adm/daemons/httpd.lpc (§7.52) -- socket_create()/socket_bind()/socket_accept()/socket_write()/socket_close() are undefined efuns under this WASM build; the resulting failed compile ('No program in object') happened during preload, before the crashed-uptime bug even got a chance to matter. Since this daemon's entire purpose is serving HTTP over sockets, gutted setup()/write_data_retry()/store_client_info()/listen_callback()/close_connection()/remove() wholesale per the standing 'disable the whole file' guidance rather than patching individual call sites. No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs (is_chinese() already codepoint-correct). Seeded fluffos/Test1234 as (admin) via adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's check_legal_password requires 6+ chars with upper+lower+digit, so the usual Mud2026Adm-style password didn't satisfy the lowercase requirement -- used Test1234 to match this lib's own rule instead). Full registration (id -> confirm -> Chinese name direct entry -> password -> confirm -> email -> gender -> character-type 0-3) and look->score->quit verified end-to-end before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean).
